recognize_zh: 這是細胞遺傳學圖片而非形態學影像：左側為 G 顯帶中期分裂相，箭頭標示三條 8 號染色體，右側核型圖第 8 對被圈起並有三條，性染色體為 X 與 Y，即 47,XY,+8 的第 8 對三體。
features: Left panel: G-banded metaphase spread with arrows marking three copies of chromosome 8
Right panel: karyogram with three chromosome 8 homologs (circled) and otherwise paired autosomes
Sex chromosomes X and Y present, giving a male karyotype of 47 chromosomes
No structural rearrangement evident at this banding resolution
Figure header labels the right panel as an interphase cell, but it is actually an arranged karyogram
describe_en: This figure is a cytogenetic image rather than a morphologic one. The left panel shows a G-banded metaphase with arrows marking three copies of chromosome 8, and the right panel is a karyogram with three chromosome 8 homologs (circled), one X, and one Y, without apparent structural abnormalities; the header mislabels the karyogram as an interphase cell. The findings represent trisomy 8 as a sole abnormality in a clonal population, reported as 47,XY,+8[13]/46,XY[7]. In a patient with MPO-negative AML confirmed by immunophenotyping, trisomy 8 is an intermediate-risk abnormality, and molecular testing should look for co-occurring mutations; constitutional trisomy 8 mosaicism should be excluded if clinically suspected.

ddx.vs: Constitutional mosaicism is present in PHA-stimulated lymphocytes or skin fibroblasts, whereas acquired +8 is restricted to the myeloid clone.
A secondary +8 accompanies recurrent rearrangements such as t(8;21), inv(16), or t(9;22), which are absent in the other analyzed chromosomes here.
MDS with +8 is distinguished from AML by a blast count below 20% and not by cytogenetics.
